text: Amends the Federal Water Pollution Control Act to allow the Steering Committee and Administrator to jointly select and periodically reassess a fiscal agent for the Patrick Leahy Lake Champlain Basin Program, with preference for entities headquartered in the Lake Champlain drainage basin or northeastern states. Authorizes the Great Lakes Fishery Commission to conduct fisheries research and aquatic invasive species work in Lake Champlain and related areas.
